headline: Ipswich and Nott'm Forest share points after first-half goals

sentences.text: Ipswich Town and Nott'm Forest drew 1–1 in Premier League matchweek 8 at Portman Road, with both goals arriving before half-time.
Neco Williams put Forest ahead in the 13th minute, assisted by Daniel Muñoz.
Ipswich responded through Julio Enciso, who equalised in the 41st minute to make it 1–1.
The score remained unchanged after the break, and the sides took a point each.
The match statistics reflected a more forceful attacking output from Forest, who had 17 shots to Ipswich's 7.
Forest also led 5–3 in shots on target and 5–0 in corners, while Ipswich recorded 3 goalkeeper saves to Forest's 2.
The clearest gap was in expected goals: Forest registered 2.29 to Ipswich's 0.46.
Possession was nearly even, with Forest at 50.6% and Ipswich at 49.4%.
The draw followed contrasting recent runs: Ipswich had collected 6 points from their previous 5 league matches, while Forest had taken 4 from their last 5.
Ipswich's sequence included 2 wins and 3 defeats; Forest had 1 win, 1 draw and 3 losses.
Ipswich moved from 10th before kick-off to 9th with 10 points from 8 matches.
Forest climbed from 19th to 16th, now on 6 points after 8 matches.
